cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Affectionate Resentment
cards.instruction: Remain warm and familiar while letting old resentment sharpen beneath every caring gesture.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've put my socks on the radiator like yours. Warm toes for you, love. No forty-minute wait this time.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Mine are drying, not warming. I said sorry about leaving you outside the office.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Yes, properly dry first. Take my warm socks; I wouldn't want you feeling forgotten as well as cold.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: They're too small. Could you just warm my feet with yours?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Come here, love. Both feet. I won't leave one outside while I finish a meeting.
